title: Finite indexed matching at a common stage transition
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $j$ let $P_j$ be a precoverage [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with isomorphism covers, finite indexed composition and base-change stability [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and covering pullbacks. Every covering presieve has finitely many arrows. Each transition $F(a)$ maps covers to covers, preserves the pullback of a covering arrow along any arrow, and is continuous for the generated topologies. Let $V$ be a cocone whose object and arrow set cocones are colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ with the same isomorphism-cover, finite closure and covering-pullback properties. Its covering presieves are exactly transported images of stage covering presieves. Each $V_j$ is continuous and preserves covering pullbacks. Fix $i\in J$ and an abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $A_t=F(t.hom)^{-1}G$ for $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, and $H=V_i^{-1}G$ [def-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-stage-image]. Suppose $\alpha_t:A_t\to V_t^*H$ and $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^*A_s$ for every $b:t\to s$ in $\mathrm{Under}(i)$ are sheaf morphisms. Composing the adjunction unit for $F(t.hom)$ with $\alpha_t$ agrees componentwise as an arrow with the adjunction unit for $V_i$. Composing it with $\theta_b$ agrees componentwise as an arrow with the unit for $F(s.hom)$. Let $W\in F(t.right)$, let $T$ be a covering presieve of $W$, and let $y_g\in A_t(\operatorname{dom}g)$ for each $g\in T$. Assume that $g\mapsto\alpha_t(y_g)$ is a compatible family in $V_t^*H$. Then there exist $s\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$ and $b:t\to s$ such that the indexed family $g\mapsto\theta_b(y_g)$ on the arrows $F(b.right)(g)$ is compatible: for all $g_1,g_2\in T$, all $Z\in F(s.right)$, and arrows $q_k:Z\to F(b.right)(\operatorname{dom}g_k)$ with $q_1F(b.right)(g_1)=q_2F(b.right)(g_2)$, their restrictions in $A_s(Z)$ are equal. Repeated image arrows retain their separate indices. No family on the image presieve or cocone refinement formula is asserted.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-pairwise-eventual-matching] to the two restrictions along each ordered pair of covering pullback projections to obtain one witnessing transition for each pair.

The shared generalized sheaf_comparison_comp theorem for arbitrary target sheaves and prescribed transposes, proved with Mathlib adjunction hom-equivalence injectivity, proves the composition law of theta as equality of Arrow.mk of its components; equality of these arrows preserves the equality relation of section images even when target endpoints differ by equality. Thus each pairwise equation persists under further transition. Since T.uncurry is finite, so is its square. Induct on its finite set of pairs. The base case uses the identity arrow. At insertion combine the existing common arrow and the new witnessing arrow by Mathlib IsFiltered.span in Under i, and use the commuting span equation and persistence to retain both sets of equations. This is formalized by the completely proved private finite_refinement lemma.

At the common transition, naturality of theta turns the equations into equality of restrictions along the mapped pullback projections. The transition preserves these pullbacks by hpullback. Any pair of arrows into the mapped covering objects with equal composites lifts to this mapped pullback by IsPullback.exists_lift. Restrict the established equality along that lift to prove the asserted indexed compatibility.

theorem colimit_site_abelian_finite_indexed_matching
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck
          Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
          t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app
        (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (t : Under i) (W : F.obj t.right) (T : Presieve W) (hT : T ∈ P t.right W)
    (y : T.FamilyOfElements
      (((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⋙
          forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (hy : (show T.FamilyOfElements
        ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙
          (ColimitSiteStageImage.target F P V Q i G).obj ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) from
        fun {Z} g hg ↦ (α t).hom.app (op Z) (y g hg)).Compatible) :
    ∃ (t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      Presieve.Arrows.Compatible
        (((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⋙
            forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (fun s : T.uncurry ↦ (F.map b.right).toFunctor.map s.val.2)
        (fun s : T.uncurry ↦ (θ t t' b).hom.app (op s.val.1) (y s.val.2 s.property))
